what: Si I 1D non-LTE abundance corrections (delta_nlte = A_NLTE - A_LTE) for SEVEN diagnostic lines 5622/5701/5708/5772/5780/6125/6254, derived by synthesising NLTE vs LTE in PySME from the Amarsi-2020 GALAH departure grid. Re-source of the 55-Cnc-clamped Family-A grid: the Amarsi grid covers [Fe/H] -> +1, closing the metal-rich clamp the prior MPIA grid (ceiling +0.30) left open. RYA-410 EXPANDED the diagnostic set to preserve the old Si_Bergemann_MPIA 7-line coverage (6 of its 7 lines, all isolated >=7A + level-matched, + the new 6125; dropped only the very weak 6067 loggf -3.1) so the swap is same-or-better coverage, not a reduction.
model_atom: Amarsi et al. 2020 Si I model atom (GALAH grid), as packaged in the Amarsi et al. 2020 (A&A 642, A62) GALAH departure grid (Zenodo v3, record 3982506, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.3982506).
derivation: PySME 1.0.1 + SME backend 6.13, MARCS marcs2012 grid. delta = A_used - A* where EW_LTE(A*) = EW_NLTE. Diagnostic-line atomic data resolved from the GES synthesis linelist (loggf/EP), grid level labels matched by nearest energy (pysme_nlte.auto_labels). _resolve_atomic clusters HFS/fine-structure components by lower-level energy and keeps the dominant gf-summed group (RYA-410 fix; the prior wide median-merge invented the Si 5772 EP-5.348 level that broke RYA-409).

validation.method: validate-don't-tune CROSS-CHECK: the PySME-Amarsi SOLAR delta must reproduce the prior registered value within 0.04 dex before the grid is trusted/swapped.
validation.result: solar (5772/4.44/0.0): PySME-Amarsi 7-line median -0.011 vs old MPIA(file) -0.004 (diff -0.007, tol 0.04) -> PASS. Si NLTE negligible in FGK dwarfs (per-line -0.008..-0.036). Reproduced, not fitted.

grid.schema: element, ion, wave_A, teff_K, logg, feh, delta_nlte
grid.nodes: 11 (Teff 5100-6200, logg 4.0-4.7, [Fe/H] -0.3..+0.6) x 7 waves = 77 rows; incl. solar + 55 Cnc (5172/4.43/+0.31) + metal-rich +0.6; LinearND-interpolated per wave. No NaN.
grid.metal_rich_closure: 55 Cnc node (5172,4.43,+0.31) resolved (no clamp); replaces the MPIA/INSPECT +0.30 ceiling that RYA-409 made loud.

registered: config.constants.NLTE_CORRECTION_ELEMENTS['Si'] (flag NLTE_Amarsi2020_PySME_1D), replacing the prior MPIA/INSPECT entry as the single source. Beast YAML verdict stays LOCKED (grid-source swap, not a regime change); RYA-400 audit green.
supersedes: the prior registered grid for this element (RYA-396/RYA-165 MPIA/INSPECT); kept in repo for reference but no longer the live correction.

solar_anchor.note: PySME-Amarsi solar median (the validate-dont-tune cross-check value); reproduces the prior registered MPIA/INSPECT delta within 0.04.
